name: Bedlam
description: Bedlam was a mysterious planet of which little was known other than stories. Dok-Ondar once acquired a relic that was supposedly from the planet. The Gen'Dai Rayvis led a marauder group known as the Bedlam Raiders during the Imperial Era.
